name: XWF World Championship
epitaph: Billed on the World/US title cage match of Rage in the Cage (4 October 2009), where the winner takes the World title and the loser the US title, and in the 2010 Universal Title Tournament page that has Zach Rizza as World Champion. 2 reigns are filed, each from a page that bills its holder.

name: XWF Universal Championship
epitaph: Billed in the Heaven & Hell Universal title match of Rage in the Cage (4 October 2009), in the Universal Title Tournament of August and September 2010, and on the X-Mas Xtreme build of December 2008. 2 reigns are filed, each from a page that bills its holder.

name: XWF United States Championship
epitaph: Billed on the Anarchy card of 18 September 2009 and the cards of October 2009; Jensen Kent shows a redesigned United States belt on 26 August 2010. 2 reigns are filed, each from a page that bills its holder.

name: XWF Hart Championship
epitaph: Billed only as a card line, 'Hart Title Standard Match', on the Columbia card of 8 October 2009, and in the funeral page's talk of a 'Hart Title hunt'. No holder is filed: no page held names who held it, or when.

name: XWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Billed as the Tag Team Titles on the Devastation card and in Nick Ryan's 'freshly won tag team gold' on 1 December 2008. Famine of the Vile's homepage of February 2009 lists two reigns of his, one with Scott Young and one with Nick Ryan, with no dates; no reign is filed.

name: XWF Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Billed on the Rage in the Cage page of 4 October 2009, where Chasm beats Nick Ryan for it, and on the Devastation card as a triple threat. 1 reign is filed, from the page that bills its holder.

name: XWF Xtreme Championship
epitaph: Billed as 'Xtreme Title #1 Contender Match' on the Columbia card of 8 October 2009; the fed's Belts folder holds a picture of it. Famine of the Vile's homepage of February 2009 lists two reigns of his, with no dates; no reign is filed.

name: XWF International Championship
epitaph: A title decided in numbered rounds on the Massacres of 12 January to 2 February 2009 (Rounds 1 to 4); no page held names the final or its winner. No holder is filed: no page held names who held it, or when.

name: XWF Canadian Championship
epitaph: Defended in a 'Canadian Rules' match on the Massacre of 8 December 2008. 1 reign is filed, from the page that bills its holder.
